title: Supply and Laying of LT Armoured Underground Cable and Internal Wiring for Residential Complex
input_text: Procurement of 1.1 kV Grade 4 Core 95 sq.mm Aluminum Conductor XLPE insulated PVC inner sheathed galvanized steel flat strip armoured and PVC overall sheathed power cable, and 1.5 sq.mm single core multi-strand copper conductor FRLSH PVC insulated unsheathed wire for internal electrical conduit wiring.

critical_clauses: Conductors must conform to IS 8130 Class 2 for Aluminum and Class 5 for Copper.
FRLSH properties must satisfy Oxygen Index > 29% per IS 10810 Part 41.
Must bear valid BIS ISI standard mark at every meter interval.

procuring_entity: Central Public Works Department (CPWD), Delhi Special Zone
title: Construction of Multi-Storeyed Institutional Building including Civil and Structural RCC Work
input_text: Supply of Thermo-Mechanically Treated (TMT) steel reinforcement bars Grade Fe-500D (Sizes: 8mm, 10mm, 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm, 32mm) and Fly-ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) in 50 kg bags for structural RCC columns, beams, raft foundation and slab casting as per structural drawings.

ground_truth.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) - Ministry of Steel & DPIIT QCOs
critical_clauses: TMT bars must have minimum elongation of 16% and total elongation at maximum force (TS/YS ratio >= 1.10) for seismic resistance.
Cement must not be older than 90 days from date of manufacture.
Bidders must provide Mill Test Certificate with heat number traceability.

procuring_entity: Water Resources Department, Lift Irrigation Division
title: Procurement of Agricultural Submersible Pumpsets and Heavy Duty Gunmetal Gate Valves
input_text: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 10 HP Three-Phase 415V 50Hz 150mm borewell submersible pumpsets with water-filled submersible motors, suitable for 80m total head and 300 LPM discharge. Along with 80mm Class-2 Gunmetal flanged gate valves and non-return check valves.

ground_truth.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) + BEE 4-Star or 5-Star Energy Rating
critical_clauses: Pump performance acceptance test must comply with IS 11346 Class C.
Motors must be wet-type water lubricated conforming to IS 9283.
Gunmetal casting body must be Grade LTB2 per IS 318.

procuring_entity: Railway Board / Northern Railway IT Cell
title: Procurement of Enterprise Laptops, Desktop Computers, and Commercial LED Panel Luminaires
input_text: Supply of Core i7 14th Gen commercial grade enterprise laptops with 32GB RAM 1TB SSD, 27-inch LED backlight displays, and 36W 2x2 feet Recessed Square LED Panel Luminaires with electronic driver for zonal administrative headquarters.

ground_truth.certification_scheme: Scheme-II (CRS - Compulsory Registration Scheme under MeitY)
critical_clauses: All IT devices and LED drivers must carry active BIS CRS registration R-Numbers embossed on products.
LED luminaire efficacy must exceed 100 lumens/watt with Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) < 10%.
